text:
[issue by LegitMeme]
### Minecraft Version

26.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

When fabric-permissions-api is present on MC 26.1 (in this case bundled by Fzzy Config), Balm attempts to load FabricPermissionsAPIIntegration but the class doesn't exist in Balm's own jar, causing a ClassNotFoundException and crashing on startup.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Install Balm 26.1.0.2 and Fzzy Config 0.7.6+26.1 together.
2. Launch the game.

### Logs

Latest: https://mclo.gs/HVJabRm
Crash report: https://mclo.gs/Jqx9OUD

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Fixed in Balm 26.1.0.3
